parsed.summary: Dr. Minji Sohl approved the revised test schedule for Sprint 2 but emphasized that the environment is not considered ready until actual validation is achieved. She requested written confirmation of the vendor timeline from Lowry Beckett to assess confidence in the stakeholder demo date.
warnings: The environment is not considered ready until actual validation is achieved.
Confidence in the stakeholder demo date depends on written confirmation of the vendor timeline.
